dog.description_text:
Meet Lola! 🦄
Lola is a beautiful black-and-white mixed breed who is ready to find her forever home! We don't have any history on this sweet girl, but what we do know is that Lola has been incredibly friendly with our staff and volunteers.

And Lola has already proven that she has a magical side! She happily allowed us to dress her up as a unicorn, making one thing very clear: Lola is a rare and beautiful creature indeed. 🦄✨

With her friendly personality, adorable looks, and willingness to go along with a little fun, Lola is sure to bring plenty of love and laughter to her future family.

If you're looking for a one-of-a-kind companion, come meet Lola. This unicorn is waiting for her happily ever after! ❤️
dog.name: Lola
